name: Shenghui Cleanness Group Holdings Limited
summary: Shenghui Cleanness Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of cleaning and maintenance services in the People's Republic of China. The company provides garbage collection and transportation, basic cleaning and maintenance, waste collection and transportation, water tank cleaning, and ancillary services to commercial and residential buildings, shopping malls, and public spaces. It also provides specialized cleaning services, such as stone cleaning and restoration, and high-altitude cleaning using mobile elevated platform, as well as engages in resale of waste recycling activities. In addition, the company engages in medical equipment leasing activities;…
